tools.name: generatePass
tools.description:
Generate a wallet pass

Generates a wallet pass from a published template. For Apple passes (default),
returns a signed `.pkpass` binary file directly. For Google passes
(`wallet_type: "google"`), returns a JSON object containing a `save_url`
that the user can open to add the pass to Google Wallet.

tools.name: getBatchGenerateLimits
tools.description:
Batch generate limits

Public metadata for `POST /passes/batch`. No authentication.

Returns the hard row cap (100), sync mode, auth summary, and stable
error codes. This path is on the site host (`https://passfa.st/api`),
not `https://api.passfa.st/functions/v1`. MCP tool:
`getBatchGenerateLimits`.

tools.name: batchGeneratePasses
tools.description:
Batch generate wallet passes

Generate up to 100 wallet passes in one **synchronous** request.
Each accepted row is one `POST /generate-pass` (same free-100 and
card-on-file gates as a single generate). Optional
`POST /share-pass/create` per successful row when `create_share_links`
is true (default)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, updatePass, listImages · Private data: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, batchGeneratePasses, downloadPassBySerial, voidPassBySerial, downloadPass, voidPass, uploadImage, deleteImage, uploadP12Certificate, uploadGoogleCredentials, listGoogleCredentials, deactivateGoogleCredential, testGoogleConnection, testAppleCertificates, updateOrganization, updateApp, getManagedSigningStatus, listWebhookEvents, listApiKeys, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, deleteApiKey, createShareToken, getSharePassMetadata, downloadSharedPass · Public sink: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, batchGeneratePasses, voidPassBySerial, voidPass, createTemplate, publishTemplate, uploadImage, uploadP12Certificate, uploadCertificate, uploadGoogleCredentials, testGoogleConnection, testAppleCertificates, createApp, updateApp, testWebhook, listWebhookEvents, createApiKey, createShareToken, getSharePassMetadata, downloadSharedPass · Destructive: deleteTemplate, uploadImage, deleteImage, getImageUsage, deleteCertificate, deactivateGoogleCredential, deleteApp, deleteApiKey.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, updatePass, listImages · Private data: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, batchGeneratePasses, downloadPassBySerial, voidPassBySerial, downloadPass, voidPass, uploadImage, deleteImage, uploadP12Certificate, uploadGoogleCredentials, listGoogleCredentials, deactivateGoogleCredential, testGoogleConnection, testAppleCertificates, updateOrganization, updateApp, getManagedSigningStatus, listWebhookEvents, listApiKeys, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, deleteApiKey, createShareToken, getSharePassMetadata, downloadSharedPass · Public sink: generatePass, getBatchGenerateLimits, batchGeneratePasses, voidPassBySerial, voidPass, createTemplate, publishTemplate, uploadImage, uploadP12Certificate, uploadCertificate, uploadGoogleCredentials, testGoogleConnection, testAppleCertificates, createApp, updateApp, testWebhook, listWebhookEvents, createApiKey, createShareToken, getSharePassMetadata, downloadSharedPass · Destructive: deleteTemplate, uploadImage, deleteImage, getImageUsage, deleteCertificate, deactivateGoogleCredential, deleteApp, deleteApiKey

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
